resources.string: A companion must be running on the PC for either mode. See Streaming settings for the setup URLs.
Flat / 3D / cinema streaming from your Apollo or Sunshine PC.
PCVR is only available on a VR headset with an OpenXR runtime installed.
PCVR requires the ALVR v20.14.1 companion on the PC that runs SteamVR. The PC setup guide is included in this APK.
Microphone permission is required for PCVR voice chat. PCVR not started.
PCVR requires ALVR v20.14.1 server installed on the same PC that runs SteamVR. The PC setup guide is included in this APK. We do not detect the PC from the headset.

Apply one of the bundled Home / Travel screen-streaming presets to the existing Moonlight streaming preferences, or use Custom to preserve whatever is currently set. Tapping Apply writes the upstream preference keys; opening this screen does not apply anything.
2560x1440 @ 72 fps, ~40 Mbps, codec auto. For a quiet wired or Wi-Fi 6 LAN.
1920x1080 @ 60 fps, ~17 Mbps, codec auto. Conservative defaults for cellular or hotel Wi-Fi; raw bandwidth is not the only factor.
Saves the choice \"Custom\" only. Your currently configured streaming settings (resolution, fps, bitrate, codec) are not touched.
PCVR quality, fixed foveated ENCODING, codec, refresh and resolution are owned by the ALVR server on the PC, NOT by this app. There are no working local sliders here.
Adaptive bitrate — on by default in ALVR; lets the server drop bitrate on packet loss.
Fixed foveated ENCODING — ALVR\'s per-tile encoder quality, not local rendering. Reduces encoder load; can save 15–25%% bitrate at slight quality cost at the periphery.
Codec — ALVR defaults to HEVC; AV1 available when the host GPU supports it; H.264 fallback for older GPUs.
Refresh rate — set on the ALVR dashboard. Quest3 hardware supports 60/72/90/120 Hz modes.
Resolution — set on the ALVR dashboard. Per-eye 1.5x–2.0x overshoot over the headset panel is typical.
Hidden on phones and TVs. Tapping here expands the same VR settings Moonlight exposes upstream; tapping a child preference behaves exactly like the upstream app.
Setup URLs and notes for the two PC companions.
